title: Detection of SARS-CoV-2 spike protein binding to ACE2 in living cells by TR-FRET
protocol: Remove the cell culture medium from HEK293T cells.
Wash the cells with 5 mL sterile PBS.
Add 1 mL trypsin/EDTA solution to detach the cells.
Incubate at 37°C for 2-5 minutes in the cell culture incubator.
Resuspend the detached cells by adding 9 mL complete DMEM medium and pipetting up-and-down using a 10 mL pipette.
Collect the cell suspension in a 15 mL conical tube.
Take an aliquot of 10 μL of the cell suspension to count live cells.
Spin down the 15 mL tube containing the cells at 180×g for 5 minutes.
Mix the 10 μL cell suspension with 10 μL trypan blue solution and transfer into a hemocytometer or automated cell counter slide.
Count live cells manually or using an automated cell counter, excluding stained dead cells.
Calculate the required volume of cell suspension to obtain 2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Aspirate the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the cell pellet in complete DMEM medium calculated to achieve a concentration of 2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Seed 1 mL of cell suspension in a new 10 cm cell culture dish containing at least 9 mL of complete DMEM medium.
Incubate cells for 18–24 hours at 37°C in a CO2 (5%) incubator to allow cells to recover and attach to the plate.
Prepare the transfection solution containing the SNAP-ACE2 plasmid.
Mix 250 μL of 150 mM NaCl with 5 μg of plasmid DNA coding for SNAP-ACE2 in one microcentrifuge tube per well to be transfected.
Add 15 μL of JetPEI reagent to another microcentrifuge tube containing 250 μL of NaCl (ratio 1:3 DNA:JetPEI).
Incubate the mixture for 15 minutes at 20°C–22°C.
Transfer 250 μL of the JetPEI-NaCl solution into the microcentrifuge tube containing the DNA.
Distribute 500 μL of transfection solution, dropwise, all over the cells that are to be transfected.
Incubate the plate in the incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 48 hours.
Ensure cell confluency does not exceed 70% before transfection.
Label N-terminal SNAP-tagged human ACE2 expressed on transfected cells' surface using Lumi4-Tb SNAP substrate.
Prepare a Lumi4-Tb SNAP substrate solution at 100 nM by mixing 5 μL of stock solution (0.1 mM) with 5 mL Tag-Lite buffer.
Remove the cell culture medium and wash cells with 5 mL sterile PBS.
Add 5 mL of the prepared Lumi4-Tb SNAP substrate solution to the washed cells.
Incubate at 20°C–22°C for 1 hour.
Remove the labeling solution after incubation.
Wash cells twice by adding 3 mL sterile PBS and removing it.
Supplement PBS solution with 1 mM CaCl2 and 0.5 mM MgCl2.
Remove PBS and repeat the washing step with PBS.
Repeat the washing step with TagLite buffer 1×.
Detach and dissociate cells by pipetting up-and-down in cell dissociation solution.
Spin down the tube containing cells at 1500 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend cell pellet in 1 ml of TagLite buffer 1×.
Verify successful SNAP labeling by adding 10 μL of cell suspension per well to a white 384-well plate.
Read the plate using a filter configuration compatible with the excitation and emission spectra of the Terbium fluorophore.
Label ACE2 with Lumi4-Tb substrate.
Ensure successful labeling of ACE2 for the TR-FRET assay.
Use mock-transfected cells to measure the background Tb signal.
Check that the signal-to-background ratio is at least 5 to 10-fold for successful SNAP labelling.
Distribute 10 μL per well of Tb-labeled SNAP-ACE2 cells into a white 384-well plate.
Add 2 μL of test compound at the desired concentration to the “test” wells.
In the “NSB” wells, add 2 μL of 3.5 μM non-labeled RBD (final concentration of 0.5 μM).
In the “BKG” and “TB” wells, add 2 μL of 1× TagLite buffer.
Seal the plate with a plate sealing film.
Incubate the plate at 20°C–22°C for 15 min.
Add 2 μL of Tag-lite buffer to “BKG” wells.
Add 2 μL of 35 nM RBD-d2 solution to all wells (final concentration of 5 nM), except in the “BKG” wells.
Incubate the plate at 20°C–22°C for 2 h.
Read the plate in a TR-FRET-compatible plate reader.
Set the Gain of the donor signal to a fixed value corresponding to the first reading for repeated measurements.
Perform triplicates for each data point.
Optional: Perform multiple reads at different time points, once every hour for example.
Read the TR-FRET signal continuously during 2 hours, starting immediately after adding RBD-d2 for association kinetics parameters.
Allow binding of RBD-d2 to reach equilibrium (incubate for 2 hours) and then add excess non-labelled RBD to displace bound RBD-d2.
Read the TR-FRET signal continuously during 2 hours, starting immediately after adding non-labelled RBD for dissociation kinetics parameters.
Export the results file as a .csv file once the reading is finished.
Calculate the TR-FRET signal by multiplying the ratio of acceptor (RBD-d2 at 665 nm) over donor (Tb-ACE2 at 620 nm) signals by 10000 for each well.
Subtract the NSB signal from the TR-FRET signal to obtain the specific signal for each well.
Normalize the TR-FRET data to the donor signal using a spreadsheet or statistics software package.
Calculate the arithmetic mean of triplicates for each sample.
Check the Tb signal homogeneity between wells to identify outliers.
Set the mean of the “TB” group as 100% and the mean of the “NSP” group as 0% for normalization.
Calculate standard deviations and statistical significance using a statistics software package like GraphPad Prism.
Plot the data in a graph using GraphPad Prism.
